timing: Post-hoc scientific questions prompted by v0.23/v0.25 results; this specification is fixed before current fits. This is not preregistration or a new untouched test.
qualification: Select graph29 by the frozen main input reported_graph_qualified=True (checked against current90-row review overlay). This is reported graph association, not certified physical reagent identity. Preserve all endpoint and metadata unknowns.
grouping: Recompute connected components of paper AND candidate constitution separately within each view. Preserve all transitive links. Validate MAIN46 closures against v0.23; graph29 may split old components, so never reuse mixed46 group labels for it.
descriptors: Exactly the ten v0.23 graph-derived physicochemical descriptors, fit-only median/mean/population SD and scaling bysqrt10. Nonchiral Morgan/Tanimoto and raw metadata are unchanged.
blocks: D=standardized descriptors/sqrt10; A=existing full8-field numeric/categorical/missing-indicator encoder/sqrt8; M=8missing flags/sqrt8. DESCRIPTOR_HALF_BLOCK_RIDGE usesD/sqrt2 to control for concatenation scaling. D+M and D+A are hstack(D,M)/sqrt2 and hstack(D,A)/sqrt2. All standalone and joint ridge models tune lambda independently inside the same inner groups.
metadata: Training-only numeric log transforms/imputation/scaling and observed categorical levels; explicit sourceID/year/author/target/qualification labels are not predictors. Unknown fields stay unknown. Adding context cannot independently identify assay causality when metadata are paper-correlated.
inner_selection: Leave one remaining training component out; minimize equal-inner-component MAE. Ties1e-12: largerlambda, or largerleaf then sqrt. No outer response used in fitting/selection.
metrics: Within each view: query-weighted MAE, equal-component and equal-paper MAE; same-query error deltas from training mean and the five fixed paired comparisons, per-source/per-component results and configuration paths. All13models and bothviews reported.
view_comparison: Graph29trained predicts its own29queries using freshly grouped29training data. Compare this with the frozen46-trained predictions evaluated on exactly the same29queries only as a retrospective training/view sensitivity. Both training composition and grouping may change; no causal identity-quality claim or cross-view MAE ranking as simple sample-size improvement.
validation: MAIN46 descriptor/kernel/RF/baselines reproduce v0.23; independent primal/SVD/eigen/tree traversal replay; train-only encoders and all source/constitution exclusion checks; selector follows inner scores; graph subset and group closures verified; pair metrics independently recomputed.
cache: Identical fit-ID/configuration predictions may be cached to avoid repeated RF fitting. Cache key includes exact sortedfitIDs and family/config; cache predictions for fixed feature-only query bank. No target for held-out query enters a cache fit. Record both logical configuration evaluations and actual cached/fresh fits.
scope_limits: No new literature acquisition, biological measurements, external test, interval calibration, source-causal correction, descriptor ablation or source-deletion retraining in this stage. MegaTrans remains deferred. Do not change frozen v0.24 validation candidate based on these post-hoc results.
stop_rule: No grid/seed/model/eligibility changes after seeing this run. Preserve unfavorable results and stop once fixed analyses and numerical checks complete.
